name: web-astro
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: Content site with Astro
description: A fast site with Astro: static pages by default, interactive islands only where needed. For blogs, docs and product sites.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Pages in `src/pages/` (each file is a route) and `.astro` components in `src/components/`.
- Everything is static HTML by default: add client-side JavaScript only through an island (`client:visible`, `client:idle`) when interaction is needed.
- Markdown content with content collections (`src/content/`).
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
